title: Window-space view cache overflow frees every cached descriptor set while earlier ring command buffers still use them
fix_note: no upstream fix (issue open); the fixed variant applies the issue's first proposal: synchronize with the outstanding command buffers (vkQueueWaitIdle) before eviction on the split path
expected_finding: at frame 3 forget_dead overflows and calls vkFreeDescriptorSets on window_space_set:hud (and the app_window sets) while the command buffers of frames 1 and 2, which bind them, may still execute: the three-deep ring only waited for frame 0's fence (VUID-vkFreeDescriptorSets-pDescriptorSets-00309)
